title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Sanders signs with Jets' active roster
items.desc: The Jets signed K Jason Sanders to their active roster.
items.impact: Sanders officially wins the starting kicking job for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody White signs with Raiders' active roster
items.desc: The Raiders signed WR Cody White to their active roster.
items.impact: White has scored three touchdowns in the past two weeks. He gets the opportunity with Jack Bech (forearm) placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Bech (forearm) placed on IR
items.desc: The Raiders placed WR Jack Bech on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bech will miss at least the next four weeks. Cody White was promoted as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devin Neal signs with Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed RB Devin Neal.
items.impact: Neal will add depth in the Vikings backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brett Rypien signs with Bucs
items.desc: The Buccaneers signed QB Brett Rypien to their practice squad.
items.impact: Rypien will add depth in the Bucs quarterback room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dowdle is likely to remain sidelined on Thursday against the Browns. Jaylen Warren should remain in the lead role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Cross (illness) ruled out Week 4
items.desc: Nick Cross has been ruled out for Week 4 against the Colts.
items.impact: Cross did not travel with the team to London. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) ruled out Week 4
items.desc: Sam Cosmi has been ruled out for Week 4 against the Colts.
items.impact: Cosmi will not make the trip to London. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Ramsey dealing with broken wrist
items.desc: Steelers CB Jalen Ramsey has a broken wrist.
items.impact: Ramsey remains hopeful to play on Thursday against the Browns. He was limited in practice to start the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was a full participant in Tuesday's practice.
items.impact: Porter has not played the first three weeks of the season as he works out a contract dispute. It appears he is on track to play on Thursday against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle reportedly 'fine' after being seen in walking boot
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is reportedly "fine" after he was spotted in a walking boot following the Broncos' Week 3 win over the Rams.
items.impact: This was reported by The Denver Post's Sam Jane. This will be something to monitor in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Juanyeh Thomas signs with Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys signed S Juanyeh Thomas.
items.impact: Thomas returns to where he began his career. He joined Dallas as an undrafted free agent and played in 36 games from 2022-2025.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Graham Glasgow works out for Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens hosted veteran G/C Graham Glasgow for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Baltimore is looking to add depth to its offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kevin Zeitler visits Packers
items.desc: The Packers hosted veteran G Kevin Zeitler for a visit on Tuesday.
items.impact: Green Bay is looking to address its banged up offensive line.

items.impact: Austin will add depth in the secondary for Dallas.

items.desc: The 49ers signed WR Dante Pettis.
